meta.title: Family names and bird groups · ชื่อวงศ์และกลุ่มนก
meta.coverage: 26 selected family terms out of 109 source families, plus 7 informal learning groups. Not all family names translated. No species added.
meta.license: CC0 1.0 (Wikidata structured labels); CC BY 4.0 (IOC 15.2 English family labels); MIT (authored Thai glosses/group definitions). CAS member records remain CC BY-NC 4.0.

cards.thai: กลุ่มเหยี่ยวและอินทรี
cards.scope: Includes the source families Accipitridae and Pandionidae; excludes falcons and owls. Includes allied kites and vultures within Accipitridae.
aliases: กลุ่มเหยี่ยวและอินทรี
cards.nameMatch: Authored learning-group definition using CAS source family/genus keys

cards.thai: กลุ่มนกเขาและนกพิราบ
cards.scope: Dove and pigeon are overlapping common-name categories in one family, Columbidae; they are not two separate families.
aliases: กลุ่มนกเขาและนกพิราบ
cards.nameMatch: Authored learning-group definition using CAS source family/genus keys

cards.thai: กลุ่มเป็ด
cards.scope: Learning group using an explicit list of duck genera in the CAS snapshot. Geese (Anser, Branta) and swans (Cygnus) are separate. Not a formal taxonomic rank.
aliases: กลุ่มเป็ด
cards.nameMatch: Authored learning-group definition using CAS source family/genus keys

cards.thai: กลุ่มห่านป่า
cards.scope: Wild geese in the source genera Anser and Branta. Domestic goose vocabulary (鹅, é) is different; domestic forms are not added as recorded wild species.
aliases: กลุ่มห่านป่า
cards.nameMatch: Authored learning-group definition using CAS source family/genus keys

cards.thai: กลุ่มหงส์
